scope: Proposition 4.10 (Weil and tensor normalization) of the manuscript “Global Arthur Enhancements of Cuspidal Excursion Parameters” (preprints/Global-Arthur-Enhancements-of-Cuspidal-Excursion-Parameters-October-5-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 98c8561d3049c5b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are identifications Θ(Z(V )) ≃ D(V ), natural and additive in V ∈ Rep L, and an element z ∈ Z(L) with the following properties. Representation morphisms become their ordinary maps on diagonal representation kernels, and the transported Weil map on D(V ) is ρV (z) ηV : r∗D(V ) −→ D(V ). (4.5) The transported tensor maps are constant; on neutral representations they can be taken to be the ordinary diagonal convolution identifications. The half-braid of Z(V ) with Z(W) becomes the ordinary interchange whenever either V or W is neutral.
